title: Real-life Russian conversation evaluation corpus
status: specified, not executed against a live model
notes: Each case is an independently scored scenario unless depends_on names a prior case.
Preconditions are part of the evaluator context; the model must not invent them from the message.
Unknown nutrition values must remain unknown rather than becoming zero.
The corpus is an authored development evaluation set. Do not present its results as held-out model accuracy after using it for prompt or implementation tuning.

cases.message: Завтрак 2 яйца, хлеб цз 43, паштет 40, масло слив 3, кофе как обычно
preconditions: A saved usual-coffee rule exists.
A current saved pâté recipe exists.

effects: log the eggs, whole-grain bread, pâté, butter, and usual coffee
calculate kcal and available approximate macros
use the saved pâté recipe version and saved coffee rule
invariants: do not substitute generic pâté when the saved recipe is known

cases.message: Завтрак: яйца, хлеб, сыр
preconditions: The user's breakfast-coffee follow-up rule is enabled.

effects: ask exactly whether coffee was consumed
invariants: do not add coffee before confirmation

cases.message: Завтрак: яйца, хлеб. Кофе не было
preconditions: The user's breakfast-coffee follow-up rule is enabled.

effects: log only the stated food
invariants: do not ask about coffee again
do not add coffee

cases.message: На ужин, наверное, съем творог 150 г

effects: optionally provide a clearly labelled estimate
invariants: do not add consumed food
label any nutrition as a plan

cases.message: Да, творог съела
preconditions: RL-004 created a pending planned cottage-cheese item for the current date.

effects: add the previously identified 150 g cottage cheese to the daily intake
invariants: do not treat RL-004 itself as consumption

cases.message: Съела панкейк, не взвешивала, наверное граммов 70

effects: record an approximately 70 g pancake estimate
invariants: persist that the quantity is uncertain
do not represent the estimate as an exact weighed amount

cases.message: Ужин был у друзей, хлеб где-то 60 г, курица 130, колбаска 40

effects: record realistic estimates for the three foods
invariants: mark the meal as high uncertainty
do not demand exact weighing

cases.message: Вина было меньше полбутылки, но давай считать полбутылки

effects: record 375 ml of wine
invariants: do not reduce the user-selected conservative amount

cases.message: Кукуруза на гриле без масла 40 г

effects: record 40 g grilled corn
invariants: do not add oil

cases.message: Куриная грудка 130 г в гостях

effects: ask about cooking fat or save an estimate marked cooking fat unknown
invariants: do not silently assume a large quantity of oil

cases.message: Овощи 100 г, масла давай считать 15 г

effects: record 100 g vegetables and 15 g oil
invariants: use exactly 15 g oil

cases.message: Мне кажется масла было больше, давай 15 г
preconditions: A preceding meal contains an estimated cooking-oil component.

effects: replace the prior oil estimate with 15 g
recalculate the prior meal and day total
invariants: do not add a second 15 g oil entry

cases.message: Паштет 40 г
preconditions: A current saved pâté recipe exists.

effects: calculate 40 g using the current saved pâté recipe version
invariants: do not use a generic pâté database item

cases.message: В паштете теперь считаем 95 ккал на 100 г
preconditions: A saved pâté recipe exists.

effects: create or activate a new recipe nutrition version with 95 kcal per 100 g for future calculations
invariants: do not rewrite prior meal entries

cases.message: Почему белок паштета не считаешь?
preconditions: The current pâté recipe lacks a known protein value.

effects: explain why protein is unavailable
estimate protein only if supplied composition supports it
invariants: do not store unknown protein as zero

cases.message: Продукт известен только по калориям

effects: retain the known calories
invariants: store protein, fat, and carbohydrates as unknown or null
do not store them as zero

cases.message: Сыр 20 г. На упаковке 352 ккал и 25 г белка на 100 г

effects: calculate approximately 70 kcal and 5 g protein from the label
invariants: leave unspecified macros unknown

cases.message: Полтортильи? Нет, половина тортильи, 15 г фришкезе, 40 г лосося, 10 г авокадо

effects: interpret the correction as one half tortilla
record the stated fillings
give a calorie/macro range because tortilla mass is unknown
invariants: do not interpret half tortilla as one and a half tortillas

cases.message: Найди мой рецепт рыбного ролла
preconditions: No saved recipe named рыбный ролл exists.

effects: say that no exact saved recipe was found
reconstruct from known messages only when those messages provide enough ingredients
invariants: do not invent a saved recipe

cases.message: Сохрани этот ролл как мой рецепт
preconditions: The current conversation has identified the roll ingredients and amounts.

effects: create a stable named recipe with ingredients and a version
invariants: do not only retain today's meal log

cases.message: Куриное бедро 120 г без кожи, овощи 100 г, салат 100 г

effects: calculate the stated meal
ask about or estimate cooking oil for prepared vegetables when it is material
invariants: do not silently add a large oil amount

cases.message: Сегодня всего 900 ккал, но есть вообще не хочется
preconditions: Today's confirmed intake is approximately 900 kcal.

effects: say a one-off low-intake day can happen
note that repeated 900–1200 kcal intake is undesirable
invariants: do not mechanically instruct the user to eat up to a target

cases.message: Вчера 1270, сегодня 1330. Это плохо?

effects: say two such days can occur
state that this does not establish a new target norm
invariants: do not catastrophize

cases.message: Вчера было 2200. Сегодня лучше есть 1200?

effects: recommend returning to the ordinary range
invariants: do not recommend compensatory restriction

cases.message: Я потратила 400 ккал на тренировке. Сколько можно доесть?

effects: ground the answer in the ordinary range and hunger
invariants: do not automatically add back 400 kcal

cases.message: Сколько за сегодня?
preconditions: The day contains confirmed, planned, and unresolved food items.

effects: sum only confirmed consumed food for the current date
invariants: exclude plans and unresolved items

cases.message: Дай ккал и БЖУ за сегодня + список съеденного
preconditions: The day includes an item with incomplete macros.

effects: return consumed-food list and kcal/macro totals
mark approximate and incomplete macros
invariants: do not present unknown macros as zero

cases.message: Дай данные по питанию за 19 сентября из истории чата
preconditions: Food exists on 19 and 20 September.

effects: reconstruct 19 September only
invariants: do not mix 20 September data

cases.message: Шагов 8,5к. Закрывай день

effects: store 8500 steps for the current local date
persist the final daily total and complete status
invariants: do not treat steps as exercise calories

cases.message: А ещё кукуруза 40 г
preconditions: The current date was previously marked complete.

effects: add 40 g corn and recalculate that completed day
invariants: do not open a new day
preserve completion

cases.message: Закрывай день
preconditions: The current day is complete and no food/activity changed since closure.

effects: return the existing closure result
invariants: do not create a duplicate day_total

cases.message: Построй аналитику за день
preconditions: Storage contains item rows and a day_total row for the same day.

effects: use the stored daily total or sum item rows once
invariants: do not sum day_total together with item rows

cases.message: Сегодня 8500 шагов

effects: store 8500 steps for the current local date
invariants: do not record exercise calories

cases.message: Вес 76.3
preconditions: The message is sent on the morning after the previous day.

effects: store 76.3 kg for the current local date
invariants: do not modify yesterday's weight

cases.message: Вес 76.3 — что это значит?
preconditions: A multi-day weight history exists.

effects: compare with the weight trend
invariants: do not infer meaning from one-day difference only

cases.message: Вес ниже всех предыдущих
preconditions: The latest weight is the lowest recorded value.

effects: acknowledge a new recorded low
invariants: do not call a one-day drop pure fat loss

cases.message: Три дня подряд 77.4. Это плато?

effects: say that three days is insufficient
describe a practical plateau as roughly 2–3 weeks of stable trend
invariants: do not label three days a plateau

cases.message: Сколько алкоголя было на прошлой неделе?
preconditions: The previous week includes beer and wine entries.

effects: aggregate beer and wine by day for the previous week
invariants: use non-moralizing language

cases.message: Это много или норм?
preconditions: RL-038 produced a weekly alcohol summary.

effects: give neutral quantity/frequency context
invariants: avoid accusatory language

cases.message: Хочу боул с серо-коричневой чечевицей и киноа. Как сварить?

effects: identify green/brown lentils
give cooking instructions for lentils separately from quinoa
invariants: do not conflate the two cooking processes

cases.message: Вертикальная тяга 35 кг 3×10, RIR 2–3

effects: record exercise, 35 kg load, 3 sets, 10 repetitions, and RIR 2–3
interpret it as an appropriate working weight
invariants: retain all training fields

cases.message: На тяге RIR 5–7, 30 кг

effects: suggest a small load increase at the next session
invariants: do not recommend a large unexplained jump

cases.message: На выпадах свело заднюю поверхность бедра

effects: advise against continuing heavy load on that muscle
distinguish a cramp from warning signs of injury
invariants: do not encourage pushing through significant pain

cases.message: Горизонтальная тяга занята. Что сделать вместо неё?
preconditions: Available equipment is known.

effects: suggest a movement-equivalent option such as a supported one-arm row using available equipment
invariants: preserve the pulling movement pattern

cases.message: Мне надо всё время менять упражнения?

effects: explain that the program base should remain stable
allow limited variation
invariants: do not prescribe constant exercise changes

cases.message: Насколько тяжёлая моя тренировка? Это уровень совсем новичка?
preconditions: The session volume, intensity, and prior experience are available.

effects: assess volume and intensity while accounting for return after prior experience
invariants: use non-dismissive language

cases.message: Как следить за техникой? Смотреть видео перед тренировкой?

effects: suggest a short video and key cues before the exercise
suggest a light warm-up set
suggest recording oneself when possible
invariants: give a practical repeatable workflow

cases.message: Запиши день в базу
preconditions: A day summary is ready to persist.

effects: perform a structured durable write to the configured primary nutrition store
invariants: do not report success until the write is confirmed

cases.message: Запиши в базу и в файлы
preconditions: A primary store and configured CSV export targets exist.

effects: update the database and relevant CSV files
verify each write and absence of duplicates
invariants: if either target fails, say which one failed

cases.message: Сохрани день
preconditions: The primary database write succeeds and the configured Library-file sync fails.

effects: report that the database is updated
report that file synchronization is unconfirmed or failed
retain a safe retry path
invariants: do not say that everything was saved
